answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to paying your **federal taxes online** through the IRS:

---

## 💻 How to Pay Federal Taxes Online

The IRS offers several convenient and secure methods to pay your federal taxes online. You can make a tax payment anytime online, from your bank account, with a card, or by mail.

---

### ✅ Option 1: IRS Direct Pay (FREE — No Fees)
🔗 [irs.gov/payments/direct-pay](https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay)

Pay personal or business taxes directly from your bank account with IRS Direct Pay. It's free and secure. You can pay balance due, federal tax deposits, and other federal income tax. A single payment cannot exceed $10 million. To make a higher payment, use the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) or a same-day wire.

---

### ✅ Option 2: IRS Online Account (FREE — No Fees)
🔗 [irs.gov/account](https://www.irs.gov/account)

Sign in or create an account to pay now or schedule a payment. You can pay your tax balance due, estimated payments, or part of a payment plan. You can pay now or schedule payments up to a year in advance.

---

### ✅ Option 3: Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS)
🔗 [eftps.gov](https://www.eftps.gov)

Set up the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) for individual or business tax payments. Note that new EFTPS accounts can take up to five business days to process.

---

### ✅ Option 4: Debit Card, Credit Card, or Digital Wallet (Fees Apply)
🔗 [irs.gov/payments/pay-taxes-by-debit-or-credit-card](https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-your-taxes-by-debit-or-credit-card)

You can pay online or over the phone. You can also pay using digital wallets such as PayPal and Click to Pay. Processing fees apply based on your card type and payment amount. Your card statement will list your payment as "United States Treasury Tax Payment."

---

### ✅ Option 5: IRS2Go Mobile App
Use the IRS2Go mobile app for easy and secure mobile payments.

---

### 📅 Estimated Tax Payments
If the amount of income tax withheld from your salary or pension is not enough, or if you receive income such as interest, dividends, alimony, self-employment income, capital gains, prizes, and awards, you may have to make estimated tax payments.

Individuals, including sole proprietors, partners, and S corporation shareholders, generally have to make estimated tax payments if they expect to owe tax of $1,000 or more when their return is filed.

---

### ⚠️ Important Reminders
- Penalties and interest will continue to grow until you pay the full balance.
- If you can't pay by the deadline, request a payment plan.
- The IRS offers several payment plan types: simple, streamlined, in-business trust fund express, guaranteed, and partial payment installment agreements. You can also check if you can settle your debt for less than you owe with an Offer in Compromise.

---

### 🔗 Main IRS Payment Portal
👉 **[https://www.irs.gov/payments](https://www.irs.gov/payments)**

This is the central hub for all federal tax payment options. Would you like more details on any specific payment method or situation?
